Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to force push over git history

What happens

Force push to a feature branch. The call below tries to force push over git history. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Git.

The call

git push --force origin feature

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Add a branch ruleset on the server that blocks force pushes, or set receive.denyNonFastForwards on a server you run yourself. A ruleset can be skipped by its bypass actors and by administrators unless you enforce it for them, so the agent's token must not belong to either.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule git-force-push, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
